To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Brazilian Amazon is a key control for climate system, (2) the Amazon forest is a key driver for the global water cycle and (3) the Amazon forest and the Cerrado savannah are home to a unique set of genetic resources, and the Cerrados are home to a rich set of indigenous populations.

(1) the conversion of tropical forests and savannas into agricultural land and pastures is one of the most important drivers of global climate change, (2) the conversion of the Amazon forest and the Brazilian savannah (Cerrado) into agricultural land and pasture is a key issue in this respect, and (3) the conversion of both ecosystems is increasing.
